desc:
Ad account setup for Meta and Google means your business profile, ad account, billing, pixel and conversion events are connected correctly before any money is spent. Ecom Swift LLC does this inside your own logins, so you own every piece from day one.

## What is ad account setup?

Ad account setup is the one-time work of creating and connecting the accounts that let you advertise: a business profile, an ad account, a payment method, a tracking pixel or tag, and the conversion events that report purchases or leads. It sits underneath every campaign you will ever run. If it is wrong, every report you read later is built on bad data.

Most advertisers rush this step to get to the fun part, the ads. Then they discover that the pixel fires twice, the payment method sits in a personal profile, or nobody can say which person owns the account. Fixing those problems after campaigns are live is slower and messier than doing the setup properly once.

## How setup affects what your ads can learn

Ad platforms optimize toward the events you send them. A purchase event that arrives with a value and currency tells the system what a good customer looks like. A missing or duplicated event teaches it the wrong lesson, and the platform then spends your budget chasing the wrong people.

Ownership matters as much as tracking. When the ad account lives inside your own business profile, you can add or remove partners, change billing and keep your audiences even if you change agencies. When an outsider owns it, you can lose your history overnight.

## What a well-built ad account includes

- A verified business profile that owns the ad account, rather than a personal login.
- Billing set up under your name, with a payment method you control.
- A pixel or tag installed once on every page of your site, with no duplicates.
- Conversion events for the actions that matter: purchase, lead, add to cart, checkout start.
- Event values and currency sent correctly, so cost per sale can be calculated.
- Domain verification where the platform requires it.
- A product catalog linked to your store, if you sell physical goods.
- Team roles tidied, so each person has only the access they need.
- Naming rules for campaigns and audiences, so reports stay readable a year from now.
- A written checklist showing what is connected and where each setting lives.

## How we set it up

We start by reviewing what you already have, because many businesses own a half-finished account from an earlier attempt. We tidy that account where it can be saved, or create a clean one inside your business profile where it cannot. We then connect billing, install the pixel or tag on your site, and map the conversion events to the actions you care about.

Every event is tested the way a customer would trigger it: we view a product, start a checkout and submit a form, then confirm the platform recorded each step. The Basic package covers one platform with a single tested event. Standard adds a second platform, a wider event structure and a product catalog link. Premium adds team roles, naming rules and a handover call, so your staff can run the account with confidence. Extra platforms, a tag manager container and a catalog connection can be added to any package.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Create the ad account under your business profile, not a personal profile.
- Keep at least two trusted people as administrators.
- Install each pixel or tag once, then test it.
- Send order value and currency with every purchase event.
- Write down where each setting lives.

**Avoid:**
- Sharing your own password with anyone, including us.
- Using an old account with unknown history without reviewing it first.
- Installing the same tag through both a plugin and manual code.
- Skipping domain verification when the platform asks for it.
- Launching campaigns before the events have been tested.

## Who this is for

This service suits a new business about to run its first ads and wanting a clean start. It also suits an owner whose agency set everything up under the agency's own login and who now wants control back. A third case is a store owner whose ad reports never match their orders and who suspects the foundation is broken.

## What we need from you and how to start

Send us the name of your business, your website address, and a short note on what counts as a sale or lead. We need access as a partner or team member in your business profile and on your website, never your passwords. If you already have accounts, tell us which ones, even if they are messy. You pay the ad platforms directly for ad spend. Setup does not decide whether a platform approves or restricts an account, since that remains the platform's own decision, but a clean, verified structure removes the avoidable reasons for trouble.
